sources.text: Synthetic packet: Official fixing4.8 is initially valid. Dealer rows are fallback quotes only; affiliate and late rows are not eligible under that fallback. Cash receipts have explicit UTC payment times. The official fixing has the source-row identifier official. When official_valid is true, used_fixing_ids must contain only official; when false, it contains the identifiers of the eligible dealer rows used.

Synthetic governing terms: All cash amounts are USD millions. Quote F is local units per USD; the contract receives N USD and pays N*K local units, net settled in USD at F. If official fixing is withdrawn, use the arithmetic average of nonaffiliated dealer quotes published by fixing_cutoff inclusive; never use the invalid official value. Intraday times are UTC minutes after midnight. Receipts at the deadline count, later receipts do not. Segregated cash cannot pay suppliers; no interest on the intraday bridge.
